answer: The wind miller works the sails with his foot, and the rhythm of the work is the rhythm of the mill. Corn flour rye thresher kneading patent is the working: a patent flour rye threshers file after threshing floor audits. The falcon is the first rhythm kept, the tundra the last before the mill falls quiet, and the karst is the quiet, the sails still on the tower. A forger faces 13 false rhythms and 13 false quiets.
